title: agora.sync-values/v1
description: R07 reusable synchronization values. These components add no HTTP operation, transport or authorization authority.

StreamCursor.description: Last committed and applied sequence for one stream. Streams have no global order.

CommandReceipt.description: R07 committed mutation receipt. It confirms a command, not that its events have been applied by a client. Duplicate actor/command/request digests return the original receipt.
